mainEntity.name: How long does a typical window replacement project take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a window replacement project varies based on the number of windows, their size, and the complexity of the installation. For a standard home, most replacements can be completed within one to three days. This includes removing old windows, preparing openings, installing new units, and finishing trim work. Larger projects or those requiring structural modifications will naturally take longer. We provide a detailed timeline during the initial consultation to set clear expectations for your specific project.
